w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Focus Group is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Callback.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Ad Break.

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: A weathered trader waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
📺 SYSTEM: "TONIGHT: The Stare-Down. A villager must out-stare an alien champion. Blinking is defeat. Seventeen systems are watching both faces."
📺 SYSTEM: "Tonight's exhibition is sponsored by the K'thari Expeditionary Veterans' Fund. Stand up straight. They're watching."

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (19/11/5), with 3 wave-4 fought, 7 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 2 · Forage 11 · Craft 6 · Talk 13 · Explore 28 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.

firenarr.line: ⚠ The store has fallen far from its recent high again — the shelves are nearly bare.
⚠ The store keeps slipping from its recent high again — evening after evening, lower.
⚠ The store has fallen further still from its recent high.

hurtreturn.line: 🧭 Pavel returns from the wilds hurt (health 5/100) — the trip cut short.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,045 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.
